method: Real level of thin-sample players (1-999 NBA minutes in the three seasons before), by years in the league. Cases: every player-season s (2011-2026) with 250+ minutes whose three seasons before s hold 1-999 NBA minutes (Basketball Reference). Own number = his Basketball Index LEBRON over those seasons, weighted by minutes and the builder's season weights (1 / 0.7 / 0.45). Forecast of his LEBRON in s = his group's level in s + m/(m+k) x (own number - his group's mean own number), m = his minutes. k and the grouping are chosen by leave-one-season-out cross-validation (squared error, offense + defense); groupings tested: one pooled group, years since his first NBA minutes (1-2, 3-4, 5+), age, years x draft round. Each group's age change is recorded so the builder can use the player's own age. Survivors only: players who did not reach 250 minutes in s are missing (see played_next_season), so the levels are an upper bound, as for the no-track-record level.
sources: Basketball Index LEBRON by season 2010-2026 (fanspo tools capture, local)
Basketball Reference minutes, ages and draft (data/research/development_evidence.json)
